hypothesis: A deterministic one-shot router selecting per-QID strategies from a frozen policy can match or exceed the best fixed global strategy on at least one primary retrieval metric (nDCG@3, Recall@3, MRR@3) across the answerable subset, without degrading abstention on the unanswerable control set.
null_hypothesis: The deterministic router does not surpass the best fixed global strategy on any primary retrieval metric across the answerable subset.

B0.label: best_fixed_global
B0.description: Best single fixed strategy across all QIDs (determined by policy replay)

B2.label: deterministic_router
B2.description: Deterministic router using frozen policy from Slice 5A.1

A1.label: tool_calling_governed_oneshot
A1.description: Governed one-shot tool calling via OneShotRunner with real retrieval adapters

O1.label: POST_HOC_ORACLE
O1.description: Per-QID best strategy selection using evaluation outcomes

metrics.generation: NOT_EXECUTED — no LLM generation in this task

denominators.answerable: QIDs with at least one relevant passage in qrels (used for retrieval metrics)
denominators.unanswerable: QIDs marked UNANSWERABLE_IN_SUBCORPUS (used for abstention metrics)
denominators.note: Metrics are computed separately; never mixed

seed: deterministic — no randomness in routing or retrieval ordering

stop_conditions.one_shot: Exactly one retrieval call per QID; no iterative refinement
stop_conditions.no_second_strategy: Router selects exactly one strategy; no fallback chain
stop_conditions.no_reformulation: Query text used as-is from the questions file

anti_leakage.qrels_access: FORBIDDEN during routing and retrieval; permitted only in post-execution analyzer
anti_leakage.historical_results: FORBIDDEN during routing; used only in post-hoc oracle analysis

success_criteria.headroom_required: Oracle must exceed best fixed on >= 1 primary metric in answerable set
success_criteria.diversity_required: Different strategies must win on different QIDs
success_criteria.determinism: Byte-identical outputs across two independent runs

interruption_criteria: Leakage detected in routing or retrieval
Non-canonical passage ID in any observation
More than one logical call per QID

limitations.sample_size: n=8 is insufficient for formal statistical significance; results are exploratory
limitations.no_llm_generation: Generation metrics are NOT_EXECUTED, not zero
limitations.deterministic_router_only: No LLM-based routing in this task
limitations.single_document_corpus: All questions reference the same PDF
